job.title: IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: IT Project Manager SAP Commerce
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

An SAP Commerce project needs someone who understands the business goal and the platform – I have combined both at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Requirements, user stories and functional specifications with business teams
– ERP / MDM / PIM integrations and API migrations delivered
– SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for REHAU.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Consultant | IT Projects, Requirements & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce professional with 5+ years delivering enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Bridges business and IT: requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications, process mapping and UAT, through to delivery in agile teams with PI Planning, Jira and Confluence. Deep hands-on knowledge of PIM / ERP / MDM integrations, API migrations, CI/CD release cycles on CCv2 and production support. Works daily with international stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: REHAU is a global industrial company whose B2B commerce must reflect complex products and processes. I know exactly that environment from Rockwell Automation, another industrial manufacturer on SAP Commerce. I want to help REHAU drive its SAP Commerce roadmap with a strong link between business departments, IT and implementation partners.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your IT Project Manager SAP Commerce role fits my profile: 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, techno-functional with business stakeholders, SAP certified. Start 16.12.2026. Happy to talk!

en.subject: Application: IT Project Manager SAP Commerce
en.hook: An SAP Commerce project succeeds when someone understands both the business goal and the platform underneath. That combination has been my daily work for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I analyse requirements with business stakeholders, plan integrations and migrations and see them through to production on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

bullets.label: Requirements & stakeholders
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions; supported user acceptance testing (UAT).

bullets.label: Complex system landscapes
bullets.text: Resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams; built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines keeping global product catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Migrations & releases
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures, improving stability and data consistency; executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

bullets.label: Agile delivery
bullets.text: Worked in agile teams with PI Planning, Jira and Confluence; performed code reviews, supported production issues and guided junior developers.

en.logistics: Coordinating with business departments, IT and international teams is a natural part of my role, and travel to Rehau or hybrid work is no obstacle. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit and can start at REHAU on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation to show you the concrete contribution I can make to your team.
